figurative_meaning_en: deceiver; cheater; cunning person; deception; fraud
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা জুয়াচোর, ব্যবসায় সবসময় ধোঁকা দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a gambling cheat who always deceives in business.
Through cheating tactics, he has duped everyone.
note: Refers to cheating in gambling, extended metaphorically to general deceit in Bengali culture.
